Use the {{artworkCount}} illustrations to build a regional flight or business aviation spread. Color profiles give the page a strong focal point, while black and white aircraft views leave room for handwritten labels.

editorial.intro: Browse Malta flag clipart with the George Cross in the corner, white and red fabric flags and outline illustrations.
paragraphs: The George Cross is a small detail on the white half of this Malta flag clipart. Look for a flag view with a clear upper corner when the cross matters, or a folded version if you want more movement in the fabric.
Pick from {{artworkCount}} illustrations for a Mediterranean geography project or a personal Malta travel album. Leave extra space for the cross if the flag will be printed beside other symbols.
